description.en: Enables or disables the "talk lock" system, which prevents the player from talking to (interacting with) map characters — used while a scripted sequence takes control.
True to lock talk interactions, false to allow them again.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Re-enable talking to map characters after a scripted sequence
CMND_SET_TALK_LOCK_STATE(false);
